articles.title: Why the Jalen Hurts optimism feels forced amid Eagles offensive rebuild
articles.standfirst: Sean Mannion’s new system is bringing Hurts’ mobility back into focus
articles.summary: Sean Mannion’s new system is bringing Hurts’ mobility back into focus
articles.body:
The Philadelphia Eagles didn't need another reminder of how badly their offense lost its rhythm last season. What they needed was evidence that the reset under Sean Mannion could unlock something that had gradually disappeared.

So far, Jalen Hurts is providing it. The quarterback has been one of the most talked-about players in Eagles camp, with coaches and teammates repeatedly pointing to the same thing, he looks quicker.

Hurts ’ rushing production declined sharply in 2025, when he finished with 421 yards and eight touchdowns on the ground, his lowest totals as Philadelphia’s full-time starter.

His designed-run usage also dropped substantially compared with earlier seasons. Mannion appears willing to change that.

The first-year offensive coordinator has incorporated more designed quarterback runs during camp while also introducing a more under-center-heavy structure, creating the possibility that Hurts could become a more active part of the rushing attack again.

Eagles defense notices Hurts’ speed

The strongest endorsement has come from the players tasked with chasing him.

“I think Jalen’s having a good camp,” defensive coordinator Vic Fangio said. “I think he looks faster.”

Fangio acknowledged that practice rules make judging sacks difficult because defenders cannot hit the quarterback, but he has seen several plays where the defense thought Hurts was trapped before he escaped.

“I think there’s been a few times where our guys think they had him and they really didn’t,” Fangio said.

Defensive tackle Jalen Carter offered an even more striking description.

“I don’t know what it is but when I’m watching and I’m running [after him], it’s like a movie, it feels like I’m going slow,” Carter said. “He be moving man, he’s been working hard and he’s the one, for sure.”

Hurts himself has resisted the idea that anything dramatic has changed physically, saying he does not “feel any different” from previous years. The offense around him, however, certainly does.

Sean Mannion asking Hurts to play faster

Hurts has emphasized that the new system still comes back to basic quarterback discipline.

“In the end, you're still playing the position, and you want to play the position the same way, play with your feet, sweep through your reads, know exactly where you're supposed to go with the ball,” Hurts said.

He added that the objective is to understand “what we're trying to attack, being on the same page and playing each play.”

That may be the most important difference after Philadelphia’s offense struggled to consistently find answers in 2025.

Mannion isn't simply asking Hurts to run more. He's trying to marry his mobility with quicker processing, cleaner footwork and a structure that can threaten defenses in several ways.

The Eagles still have high-end talent around him, including Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith . Yet Hurts remains the player capable of changing the ceiling of the entire unit.

If the version teammates are seeing in camp carries into the regular season, Philadelphia may not just have a refreshed offense. It may have rediscovered the quarterback who once made it so difficult to defend.

articles.title: Jalen Hurts POV Cam shows just how difficult playing quarterback in NFL is
articles.standfirst: The Philadelphia Eagles showcased to fans what playing QB against an NFL defense is like.
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles showcased to fans what playing QB against an NFL defense is like.
articles.body:
By this point, it's practically known by everyone just how hard it is to play quarterback at a high level. Despite that, every NFL season comes and goes, and professional QBs are still criticized week-in, week-out .

That's the nature of playing such a high-profile position, and getting paid lots of money to do it. But there's a reason the very best quarterback get paid so much: It's one of the hardest jobs in all of sports . POV cams in the past have amplified that notion, with Tua Tagovailoa 's version with the Miami Dolphins going viral a couple of years ago.

Playing quarterback is way harder than many make it look on TV

Now, the Philadelphia Eagles have given fans an up-close look at what their quarterback, Jalen Hurts , has to go through on a per-snap basis. Making that particular play even more difficult was that it came from close to the goal line, so defenders and pass-catchers were more condensed.

Hurts was able to progress through his reads and find a pass-catcher for a touchdown . Still, it left many fans baffled at how he was even able to sit in the pocket and find his receiver.

" I don’t think people realize how hard it is to be a QB lol "

" Genuinely how tf do quarterbacks ever complete a pass "

" Genuinely this is so funny because people think playing QB isn’t one of the hardest things in the world and then you see an actual POV of a QB and it’s f**king impossible lol "

Hurts has one of the better offensive lines around the league, too, so fans can only imagine what it looks like from the pocket for a quarterback behind a bad offensive line.

articles.title: Saquon Barkley could return to MVP form, and that’s bad news for the NFC East
articles.standfirst: Saquon Barkley is back? The NFC East could be in trouble.
articles.summary: Saquon Barkley is back? The NFC East could be in trouble.
articles.body:
After delivering what was arguably the best individual season by a running back in NFL history in 2024, Saquon Barkley saw his production decline in 2025, just like the Philadelphia Eagles , who were unable to replicate the dominance they displayed the previous year.

However, “coming back down to earth” for Barkley still meant finishing with 1,140 rushing yards , the fourth-best mark of his career. The difference was that, after becoming a constant threat with explosive 30, 40, and even 50-plus-yard runs during his first season in Philadelphia , things became much more difficult for the star running back in his second year with the team.

Barkley went from recording 11 games with more than 100 rushing yards in 2024 to just three in 2025 , raising questions about whether he could return to the level that made him one of the league’s most dominant players.

The biggest question is whether the 29-year-old running back has reached the point that many veteran players at the position eventually face: a physical decline that prevents them from replicating historic seasons. But according to Lane Johnson , there is still plenty left to expect from Barkley.

During Wednesday’s Eagles practice, the veteran offensive lineman made it clear that fans should not count out the No. 26 and predicted a version of Barkley much closer to the one that dominated in 2024 .

Lane Johnson believes in Saquon Barkley’s resurgence

“The more productive we are in the run game and stuff feeds off that, we'll see the Saquon from two years ago. We'll see the big plays, we'll see him flex wide at wide receiver, we'll see him in the screen game,” Johnson said via The Athletic’s Zach Berman .

Although Barkley is entering his ninth NFL season, his workload is not comparable to many running backs his age. The three-time Pro Bowler has played only 113 career games after missing most of the 2020 season due to injury and appearing in just seven playoff games during his time with the New York Giants because of the team’s struggles to reach the postseason.

Even though Barkley’s career is entering an advanced stage for a running back, Johnson believes he still has plenty left in the tank. And if he is right, Eagles fans could once again see the explosive version of the player who dominated the NFL in 2024 .

articles.title: Kylie Kelce liked Jason treating her like an object at the gym… What does she mean by that?
articles.standfirst: A simple request for workout advice turned into a flirty exchange between the couple
articles.summary: A simple request for workout advice turned into a flirty exchange between the couple
articles.body:
There are plenty of reasons married couples choose not to work out together. In the Kelce household, one of them apparently involves Jason Kelce being unable to focus.

Kylie Kelce opened up about the couple’s gym dynamic during an appearance on Ilona Maher’s new workout series Power Hour, explaining that her retired NFL husband isn't exactly the person she turns to when she wants serious feedback.

Asked whether she and Jason train together, Kylie didn't hesitate: “God, no. I don’t hate myself that much,” she joked.

She then explained that they have worked out together in their garage before, including one session in which she was performing Romanian deadlifts and wanted Jason to check her technique.

“After a minute of me doing it, I was like, ‘Critique my form’,” Kylie recalled. “And he was like, ‘I’m gonna be honest, I’m really distracted.’ And I was like, ‘You’re useless’.”

Kylie not offended by the attention

Maher quickly picked up on what had distracted the former Philadelphia Eagles center and suggested Kylie might need a more neutral training partner.

“You’ve gotta get a third party who’s not gonna objectify you,” Maher joked. “That’s tough to have somebody objectifying you like that in the gym.”

Kylie’s response made clear that she was not particularly bothered: “I actually kind of liked it,” she said with a grin.

The conversation then shifted to whether the attraction goes both ways, and Kylie was equally direct when Maher asked if she objectifies her husband: “1000%, I do,” she replied.

“Because it’s all about equality,” Maher joked. “We’re feminists,” with Kylie replying: “Thank you. Yeah, we’re feminists. Have you seen his shoulders?”

Flirting part of Jason and Kylie’s marriage

The exchange fits with how Kylie has previously described her relationship with Jason. The couple met on Tinder and married in 2018. They now have four daughters, Wyatt, Elliotte, Bennett and Finn .

Earlier this year, Kylie said on her Not Gonna Lie podcast that she expects the flirting to continue even after years of marriage and the demands of raising a family.

“I actually give my husband s**t if he walks past me in the kitchen, doesn’t, like, grab my ass,” she said. “Flirt with me. Imma flirt with you. You better flirt with me.”

That makes the gym story less of an isolated joke and more of a glimpse into the way the couple has kept a playful dynamic alive.

Jason may not be much help when it comes to critiquing Kylie ’s deadlift form. Judging by her reaction, though, she doesn't seem especially interested in fixing that particular problem.

articles.title: A.J. Brown gives Jalen Hurts cold shoulder in heated Patriots-Eagles reunion
articles.standfirst: The former Eagles stars embraced and spoke privately after Thursday’s joint practice
articles.summary: The former Eagles stars embraced and spoke privately after Thursday’s joint practice
articles.body:
The most telling moment of A.J. Brown ’s first week working opposite the Philadelphia Eagles didn't come during a route, a touchdown or a competitive rep. It came after practice, when he turned around, headed back toward his former teammates and sought out Jalen Hurts .

The two embraced, spoke privately for several minutes and then dapped each other up before leaving the field Thursday, according to multiple reporters covering the joint session between the New England Patriots and Eagles.

It mattered because Brown had acknowledged only a day earlier that he and Hurts hadn't spoken since Philadelphia traded him to New England in June.

Their public comments had already hinted there was no open hostility. Brown said there was still love on his side, while Hurts made clear that his affection for his former teammate had not disappeared.

The post-practice conversation gave those words more weight.

Brown and Hurts more than routine quarterback-receiver pairing

During four seasons together, Brown and Hurts became one of the defining offensive partnerships in Philadelphia.

They helped the Eagles reach two Super Bowls, win one championship and produce some of the strongest offensive seasons in franchise history.

Their relationship also extended beyond football, with Hurts serving as the godfather to Brown ’s daughter. That history is why the silence following the trade drew attention.

The joint practices this week marked the first time the two had been placed on opposite sides, and Brown made himself visible against his former defense with several touchdowns during competitive periods.

Yet the most significant development may have been what happened once the work ended.

Both players trying to move forward

Brown ’s final stretch in Philadelphia wasn't especially smooth.

He finished the Eagles ’ playoff loss to the San Francisco 49ers with three catches for 25 yards on seven targets, dropped two passes and had a heated sideline exchange with head coach Nick Sirianni .

His move to New England gave him a fresh start and reunited him with Mike Vrabel , who previously coached him with the Tennessee Titans.

Hurts , meanwhile, is adapting to another offensive reset. Sean Mannion is now calling plays, continuing a pattern of coordinator changes throughout the quarterback’s career.

“Jalen's been awesome,” Mannion said. “I really think he can do anything we ask of him.” The football consequences of Brown ’s departure will take much longer to evaluate.

The personal story appears clearer. After weeks of questions about whether the relationship had gone cold, Brown and Hurts finally spoke face to face.

articles.title: Dean Blandino reveals Taylor Swift's frustration with famous tactic Eagles used to stop Chiefs
articles.standfirst: A conversation about the NFL’s tush push helped create a friendship with the global superstar
articles.summary: A conversation about the NFL’s tush push helped create a friendship with the global superstar
articles.body:
T aylor Swift ’s connection to the NFL has mostly been defined by her support of Travis Kelce and the Kansas City Chiefs , but Dean Blandino has revealed the singer also has strong opinions about one of the league’s biggest debates.

The former NFL vice president of officiating said Swift unexpectedly approached him after a Chiefs-Eagles matchup and immediately shared her thoughts on Philadelphia’s controversial “tush push” play.

Blandino , who now works as a rules analyst for FOX Sports, said the conversation happened at Patrick Mahomes ’ birthday party last September after Kansas City faced Philadelphia. What started as a football discussion eventually turned into a friendship with Swift and Kelce .

“We did a game in Kansas City last year. This person came up to me, gave me a big hug, and said that she agreed that the tush push sucks, and it was Taylor Swift, and we just hit it off and became friends,” Blandino said on the House of Haymaker podcast.

The meeting later led to Blandino receiving an invitation to Swift and Kelce ’s wedding at Madison Square Garden, where around 1,000 guests attended the July ceremony.

Taylor Swift joins debate over Eagles’ signature play

The “tush push” has become one of the NFL’s most talked-about strategies since the Philadelphia Eagles turned it into a near-automatic short-yardage weapon.

The play involves teammates pushing quarterback Jalen Hurts from behind to help gain extra yards, especially in situations where Philadelphia needs a first down or touchdown. While the Eagles have found tremendous success with the formation, it has also attracted criticism from fans, analysts, and opponents who believe the tactic should be reviewed or banned.

Swift ’s reported reaction puts her among those who have questioned the play, although she has not publicly called for the NFL to eliminate it.

Her opinion also carries an interesting connection because of her history with Philadelphia. Swift has performed at Lincoln Financial Field and has reportedly supported improvements at the stadium, including changes made around her Eras Tour appearance.

However, since beginning her relationship with Kelce , her NFL loyalty has shifted toward Kansas City, making the Eagles a natural rival from a football perspective.

The Chiefs and Eagles aren't scheduled to meet during the regular season, meaning Swift may only have to watch the tush push again if the teams meet in a future playoff matchup.

Blandino explains how unlikely friendship began

Blandino ’s story highlights another side of Swift ’s growing connection to football. While she has become one of the NFL’s most visible celebrities, the conversation showed her willingness to engage with the sport beyond simply supporting Kelce .

Since joining FOX Sports in 2017, Blandino has become a familiar face for NFL fans, breaking down complicated rules decisions and explaining controversial officiating calls.

His relationship with Swift developed from a simple football conversation, with the former official saying the two “hit it off” after discovering they shared the same view on the Eagles ’ most famous play.

Swift has become a major part of the NFL conversation over the past two seasons, but Blandino ’s story offers a different perspective on her involvement. Away from the spotlight, she is also following the details of the game and forming opinions on the strategies that shape it.

And when it comes to the tush push, it appears Swift is firmly in the group that would rather see it disappear.

articles.title: Eagles star Ja'Quinden Jackson discharged the hospital following hard hit suffered against Patriots
articles.standfirst: Philadelphia running back avoided a serious injury after frightening opening kickoff collision
articles.summary: Philadelphia running back avoided a serious injury after frightening opening kickoff collision
articles.body:
The Philadelphia Eagles received a major scare during their preseason matchup against the New England Patriots when running back Ja’Quinden Jackson was taken from the field in an ambulance following a violent collision on the opening kickoff.

Hours later, the team and Jackson ’s representatives provided a much more encouraging update. Jackson was injured while covering the kickoff and making a tackle on Patriots returner Lan Larison .

After the play ended, the 24-year-old running back remained motionless on the field, prompting medical staff from both teams to rush over as players from both sidelines gathered in concern.

The Eagles announced that Jackson had movement and strength in all four extremities before he was transported to a local hospital for further evaluation. His agent, Damien Butler , later confirmed that Jackson was awake, alert and had received positive medical results.

“Ja’Quinden is awake, has full movement and use of all four limbs, and his CT scan came back negative,” Butler said in a statement.

“We are extremely grateful to the Philadelphia Eagles ’ medical staff and the first responders whose swift actions and exceptional care supported Ja’Quinden during this critical moment.”

Jackson was later released from the hospital and returned to Philadelphia with the Eagles .

Eagles teammates relieved after frightening scene

The emotional reaction from players highlighted how serious the moment appeared on the field. Eagles quarterback Tanner McKee said the team was immediately concerned after seeing Jackson remain down following the tackle.

“A lot of different emotions just praying and hoping that he’s OK,” McKee said. “Word was going around that he was talking, he was responsive and moving. That kind of got everybody to settle down a little bit and we know our teammate is doing OK.”

Head coach Nick Sirianni also admitted that watching the injury unfold was difficult for everyone involved.

“That’s always rough to see that,” Sirianni said. “I know our guys care about each other and so that’s tough. That’s tough… I’m glad he’s doing OK.”

Jackson ’s injury occurred less than a minute into the preseason contest, briefly stopping the game as medical personnel worked with him. He was placed on a stretcher and loaded into an ambulance, but he was seen raising his left arm as he was taken away from the field.

Jackson fighting for roster spot

The injury came at a crucial time for Jackson , who signed with Philadelphia earlier this month after spending the 2025 season on the Jacksonville Jaguars ’ practice squad.

The former Arkansas standout entered training camp competing for a place in a crowded Eagles running back room that includes Saquon Barkley, Tank Bigsby, Dameon Pierce, Will Shipley and Carson Steele .

Jackson went undrafted in 2025 after rushing for 790 yards and 15 touchdowns during his final college season at Arkansas. His performances earned him second-team All-SEC honors before he began his NFL journey.

paragraphs: The Philadelphia Eagles received a major scare during their preseason matchup against the New England Patriots when running back Ja’Quinden Jackson was taken from the field in an ambulance following a violent collision on the opening kickoff.
Hours later, the team and Jackson ’s representatives provided a much more encouraging update. Jackson was injured while covering the kickoff and making a tackle on Patriots returner Lan Larison .
After the play ended, the 24-year-old running back remained motionless on the field, prompting medical staff from both teams to rush over as players from both sidelines gathered in concern.

The Eagles announced that Jackson had movement and strength in all four extremities before he was transported to a local hospital for further evaluation. His agent, Damien Butler , later confirmed that Jackson was awake, alert and had received positive medical results.
“Ja’Quinden is awake, has full movement and use of all four limbs, and his CT scan came back negative,” Butler said in a statement.
“We are extremely grateful to the Philadelphia Eagles ’ medical staff and the first responders whose swift actions and exceptional care supported Ja’Quinden during this critical moment.”
Jackson was later released from the hospital and returned to Philadelphia with the Eagles .
Eagles teammates relieved after frightening scene

The emotional reaction from players highlighted how serious the moment appeared on the field. Eagles quarterback Tanner McKee said the team was immediately concerned after seeing Jackson remain down following the tackle.

“A lot of different emotions just praying and hoping that he’s OK,” McKee said. “Word was going around that he was talking, he was responsive and moving. That kind of got everybody to settle down a little bit and we know our teammate is doing OK.”
Head coach Nick Sirianni also admitted that watching the injury unfold was difficult for everyone involved.
“That’s always rough to see that,” Sirianni said. “I know our guys care about each other and so that’s tough. That’s tough… I’m glad he’s doing OK.”

Jackson ’s injury occurred less than a minute into the preseason contest, briefly stopping the game as medical personnel worked with him. He was placed on a stretcher and loaded into an ambulance, but he was seen raising his left arm as he was taken away from the field.
Jackson fighting for roster spot
The injury came at a crucial time for Jackson , who signed with Philadelphia earlier this month after spending the 2025 season on the Jacksonville Jaguars ’ practice squad.
